name: Nem chua
summary: Nem chua is a night snack on the mobile kiosks at Đào Tấn, sold with the corn, sweet potato, and squid.
origin: Đào Tấn, Vinh, on the 28 April 2023 Báo Nghệ An page.
howToEat: Buy it at the mobile kiosks. Báo Nghệ An does not say what meat is in it or how it is cured. A price is Check on arrival. Báo Nghệ An says prices are posted and prints no figure.
where: Đường Đào Tấn mobile kiosks, 18:00–06:00 on the 27 April 2023 account, then the pavement is cleared. A 2026 night list was not opened.
